status.name: BAD_VALUE
status.description: Range, alignment, profile, or reserved value invalid

status.name: BAD_STATE
status.description: Command not permitted in current state

status.name: BAD_IMAGE
status.description: Incomplete image or whole-image CRC mismatch

status.name: NO_FRAME
status.description: No complete source frame since reset

status.name: STEP_LIMIT
status.description: Budget exhausted; paused without next retirement

trace.name: INTERRUPT
trace.description: Completed interrupt entry; separate event, not instruction retirement

frame.name: BYTES
frame.description: Four shades per byte; first pixel in bits 1:0

command.name: READ_HOST
command.description: Read exactly one aligned host register; unknown addresses fail.

command.name: RESET
command.description: Pause at a dot boundary and initialize direct state; retain valid ROM and profile.

command.name: RUN
command.description: Resume from retained phase; acknowledgement after transition.

command.name: HALT
command.description: Host pause at next dot boundary; already paused is idempotent.

command.name: STEP
command.description: Advance until next completed instruction or the requested dot budget; interrupt entry does not satisfy retirement.

command.name: LOAD_BEGIN
command.description: Validate metadata, pause/reset, invalidate old image and start a fresh load.

command.name: LOAD_WRITE
command.description: Write 1..252 image bytes, marking each byte present; ranges cannot cross image end.

command.name: LOAD_END
command.description: Require every byte written and expected CRC32; reset and mark image valid, paused.

command.name: READ_ROM
command.description: Read exact image storage bytes; host offsets never denote CPU or host registers.

command.name: INPUT
command.description: Apply full button mask at next dot boundary, or immediately while paused; return completed dot count.

command.name: SNAPSHOT
command.description: Copy last completed source frame to dedicated immutable host snapshot; fail if none since core reset.

command.name: READ_FRAME
command.description: Read dedicated snapshot, unchanged until next successful SNAPSHOT or global reset.

command.name: WRITE_HOST
command.description: Write a whitelisted host control register.

command.name: RUN_DOTS
command.description: Run a bounded number of real dots and pause

input_source.name: UART
input_source.description: Use the host button mask; reset default.

input_source.name: PHYSICAL
input_source.description: Use the coherent physical button mask.

offset.name: offset
offset.description: ROM file offset or snapshot byte offset

dot.name: dot
dot.description: Number of completed emulated dots at transition

retirement.name: seq
retirement.description: Event index from zero within epoch

retirement.name: pc_before
retirement.description: PC before instruction or interrupt entry

retirement.name: opcode
retirement.description: Fetched bytes in bits 7:0 then 15:8 then 23:16; unused bytes zero

retirement.name: opcode_length
retirement.description: 1..3 for instruction; zero for interrupt entry

retirement.name: buttons
retirement.description: Effective Game Boy button mask at event end

write_host.name: value
write_host.description: Value with all reserved bits zero.

run_dots.description: Actual ticks executed by this operation
